ratios.quote: On a rolling twelve-month basis, the Total Leverage Ratio, defined as consolidated total indebtedness to consolidated EBITDA, shall not exceed 3.50 to 1.00 (for the twelve months ended March 31, 2026, the Company’s Total Leverage Ratio was 2.16 to 1.00).

On a rolling four-quarter basis, the Senior Secured Leverage Ratio, defined as the ratio of consolidated senior secured net indebtedness to consolidated EBITDA, shall not exceed 3.00 to 1.00 for any fiscal quarter ending on or after September 30, 2024 (for the twelve months ended March 31, 2026, the Company’s Senior Secured Leverage Ratio was 2.14 to 1.00).

On a rolling twelve-month basis, the Interest Coverage Ratio, defined as consolidated EBITDA to cash consolidated interest expense, shall not be less than 3.00 to 1.00 (for the twelve months ended March 31, 2026, the Company’s Interest Coverage Ratio was 4.89 to 1.00).

parsed.notes: Senior Secured Leverage and Interest Coverage covenants apply only while amounts or exposure are outstanding under the revolver or Term Loan A (both outstanding at 3/31/2026). The Total Net Leverage Ratio (2.14x vs 3.50x) is only a threshold restricting voluntary prepayment of unsecured/subordinated debt, and the 2.50x/2.75x Total Leverage tiers restrict dividends/buybacks; these are not maintenance covenants and are excluded. The Net Debt Leverage Ratio (2.19x; 1.57x at 12/31/2025) is a non-GAAP management metric with a 1.50x-2.00x target, not a covenant, and is excluded. Company reported compliance with all financial covenants.
